name: Programming language
description: Read short real code, name the language and goal, then explain subtle bugs.
skillInstructions:
# Programming language

Keep snippets to one to five lines; name the language in the code part and the goal in the prompt.

- Use picks when several lines look plausible but only one respects the goal.
- Hints explain why the other lines fail; they never quote the correct line.
- Ask for the method or keyword, not a full restatement of the snippet.
- Do not require a runtime, a build step or an external package.

cards.summary: Fold a list into one value

prompt.text: const total = items.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 0);
Name the array method that folds every item into one value.

teaching.text: A fold walks a list while carrying one running value.

prompt.text: In JavaScript, a loop that visits every element of an iterable is a

answer.text: In JavaScript, a loop that visits every element of an iterable is a for-of loop.

teaching.text: It takes one item at a time from the iterable.

prompt.text:
let count = 1;
for (const item of items) count += 1;
Which single line must change so the final count equals the number of items?

teaching.text: The first value decides what the running total begins with.
